verdict.rationale: An admin audit log is a fair security question for a work-management tool like GitHub Projects, but the evidence pack never documents one. It covers views, custom fields, workflows, status updates and the GraphQL API, with no mention of audit logs or logging of workspace-wide actions. Item-sync behavior and API queries are related features, not an audit log, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can review an admin audit log of actions taken across the workspace
